verdict.rationale: Fireflies' documented capture mechanism is bot-based — 'Invite fred@fireflies.ai to a live meeting or have it autojoin your calendar meetings to record' — meaning a visible bot participant joins calls; there is no evidence of a desktop-app/device-audio capture mode that avoids a visible bot. The only alternative is uploadAudio for pre-recorded files, which doesn't address live-meeting capture without a bot.
